preconditions.description: The grid size n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid has n rows and each row has n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'S', 'G', '.'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'S', 'G', or '.'.

postconditions.description: The output is one of 'UNIQUE', 'NONE', or 'MULTIPLE'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'UNIQUE' and len(result) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in result) and all(cell in {'S', 'G'} for row in result for cell in row)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', the result is an n x n grid with each cell being 'S' or 'G'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'UNIQUE' and all(sum(1 for x in (grid[i][j], grid[i-1][j], grid[i+1][j], grid[i][j-1], grid[i][j+1]) if x == grid[i][j]) == 3 for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if grid[i][j] != '.')
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', each pre-filled cell is adjacent to exactly 2 tiles of the same color.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'UNIQUE' and all(sum(1 for x in (result[i][j], result[i-1][j], result[i+1][j], result[i][j-1], result[i][j+1]) if x == result[i][j]) == 3 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', each cell in the result is adjacent to exactly 2 tiles of the same color.
